beta.note: The beta engine records findings along the walk and folds them into one card. It is a separate surface from the decision tree editor.

list.title: Beta designer
list.subtitle: Trees that register findings and fold them into one card per cell.
list.loadFailed: The beta tree list could not be read.

create.title: New beta tree
create.codeHelp: Lower snake case. It is the identity and the address, so it cannot be changed later.
create.badCode: Use lower case letters, numbers and underscores.
create.duplicate: A beta tree with that code already exists.
create.scopeHelp: Per cell gives one card for each grid cell. Per block gives one for the whole block.

designer.loadFailed: This tree could not be read.
designer.publishFailed: The publish did not go through.
designer.readOnly: This tree belongs to another scope, so it is read-only here.
designer.discardConfirm: The draft is removed and the tree goes back to its published version. This cannot be undone.
designer.discardWhy: Saving cannot replace a draft: an unchanged body writes no version, so a draft that will not publish would block every later author.
designer.noDraft: No draft. The published version is on screen.
designer.readOnlyNoPermission: You do not have permission to change this tree.

canvas.hint: Click a node to edit it. Ctrl and scroll to zoom, drag the background to pan.
canvas.deleteFailed: That node could not be deleted.
canvas.empty: This tree has no root node yet.
canvas.hintDraggable: Click a node to edit it, drag a node to move it. Ctrl and scroll to zoom, drag the background to pan.

node.title: Node
node.changeKindHelp: Changing the kind clears the fields the old kind owned.

register.title: Finding
register.severityHelp: Severity lives on this node, not on the catalogue. The same finding can be a warning here and critical elsewhere.
register.notDeclared: This code is not in the tree's registers list.

set.title: Variables
set.name: Name
set.empty: This node writes no variables yet.

switch.title: Bands
switch.cases: Cases, in order. First match wins.
switch.defaultHelp: Required. A switch that matches no case stops the walk and the trace status is error. The editor pre-fills this with the node that came next; change it if it is wrong.
switch.noCases: No cases yet. Every cell would take the default.

stop.title: Stop
stop.help: The walk ends here and the findings recorded along it fold into one card.

findingPicker.title: Findings
findingPicker.sourceHelp: Platform codes resolve first. A tenant code with the same name is never read.
findingPicker.loadFailed: The finding catalogue could not be read.

registers.title: Declared findings
registers.help: The codes this tree may register. Every register node is checked against this list, and every entry against the catalogue.
registers.empty: This tree declares no findings yet.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.subtitle: A rule supplies the card text when it matches a finding set exactly. Every other set composes from the findings' own clauses.
combinations.composesHelp: No rule matches this set exactly, so the card joins each finding's clause in severity order.
combinations.empty: This tree can produce no finding set yet. Add a register node.
combinations.emptySetHelp: An empty set means no card.
combinations.truncated: The tree has more routes than this list can walk. These are the first {{count}} sets found.
combinations.orphanHelp: These rules name a set this tree cannot produce today. They are not a publish rejection, but they never fire.

form.title: Combination rule
form.codesHelp: Picked from the tree's declared findings. A rule matches this set exactly, not as a subset.
form.duplicate: Another rule already matches this set.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.subtitle: Walk the draft over one block and read the fold per cell.
dryRun.failed: The dry run did not finish.
dryRun.noBlocks: No block is in this tree's targeting.
dryRun.platformScope: The dry run reads a tenant's blocks. A platform account has none, so open this tree from a tenant account to run it.
dryRun.noCells: This block has no grid, so there are no cells to fold.
dryRun.saveFirst: Save the draft first. The run walks the stored version, not the unsaved edit.
dryRun.blocksFailed: The block list could not be read.

publish.title: Publish checks
publish.failed: The publish checks could not be run.
publish.notChecked: Nothing has come back for this version. The server checks it on save and on publish.
publish.errorsCount_one: {{count}} error. Fix it, then save again.
publish.errorsCount_other: {{count}} errors. Fix them, then save again.
publish.hintsHelp: Checks this screen can run on its own. The server runs the full set on save and on publish, and its answer is the one that decides.

rule.yaml_unparsed: The tree body is not valid YAML.
rule.missing_root: The tree has no root node.
rule.unknown_root: The root points at "{{node}}", which is not a node.
rule.switch_without_default: "{{node}}" has no default. A switch that matches no case stops the walk and the trace is an error.
rule.switch_default_unknown: The default of "{{node}}" points at "{{target}}", which is not a node.
rule.switch_no_cases: "{{node}}" has no cases, so every cell takes the default.
rule.switch_no_subject: "{{node}}" switches on nothing. Pick a reading.
rule.register_missing_code: "{{node}}" registers no finding. Pick a code.
rule.register_not_declared: "{{node}}" registers "{{code}}", which the tree does not declare.
rule.register_unknown_code: "{{code}}" is in no finding catalogue, platform or tenant.
rule.unreached_stop: No route from "{{node}}" reaches a stop node.
rule.dangling_pointer: "{{node}}" points its {{slot}} at "{{target}}", which is not a node.
rule.unreachable_node: "{{node}}" cannot be reached from the root.
rule.mixed_leaf_kinds: "{{node}}" carries an outcome block. A beta tree folds its findings and has no outcome leaves.
rule.combination_unknown_code: Combination rule {{position}} names "{{code}}", which this tree never registers.
rule.duplicate_combination: Combination rule {{position}} matches the same set as rule {{first}}.

catalogue.title: Finding catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: The shared vocabulary. One row per finding code: its clause, its short name and its default health status.
catalogue.platformHelp: Shipped with the platform. Every tenant reads these.
catalogue.tenantHelp: Written here. A tenant may add a code without waiting for the platform.
catalogue.shadowedHelp: A platform row has this code, and the fold reads the platform table first. This row is never read.
catalogue.loadFailed: The finding catalogue could not be read.

form.codeHelp: Lower snake case. It is the identity, so it cannot be changed later.
form.nameHelp: The short label on a group header.
form.clauseHelp: One clause, joined with the others when a card composes its text. Write it lower case with no full stop.
form.defaultStatusHelp: The health class this finding gives a cell. A combination rule may override it; the worst status wins.
form.badCode: Use lower case letters, numbers and underscores.
form.duplicate: A finding with that code already exists in this table.
form.clauseNoComma: A clause must not contain a comma. The card joins it to others, so write one fragment. Two ideas mean two findings.

catalogue.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate the finding "{{code}}"? The row stays, because the code is stored in every card that ever carried it. A tree that registers it will stop compiling.
catalogue.tenantPlatformScope: A platform account is not in a tenant, so there is no tenant catalogue to read here.

condition.title: Test
condition.empty: This node tests nothing yet, so every cell takes the miss branch.
condition.unsupported: This test was written by hand in a shape the editor does not offer.
